conclusion: Substantial source-backed slices are implemented and tested. Complete visual, rules, content and behavioral 1:1 equivalence is not established and is not claimed.
method: Independent file/source/report review plus current production-channel, real-WASM and real-GLES QA. New five-world proof uses createSeasonSession for terrain, ground and model skins, reflected scene capture and camera heading. No GUI, original executable or browser process launched.

referenceProfile.numericalTables: Explicit BASE db.zip/hdrs.zip profiles; current 57 definition roles are not the full original roster.
referenceProfile.installedConfiguration: The three inspected shortcuts target the root launcher. Local configuration requests enabled UP content and DX9. EnabledUP15UnitsDX9/EE2.exe is an inferred candidate, not an observed launcher branch.
referenceProfile.codeReuseEvidence: All four installed enabled/disabled UP and DX9/non-DX9 engine candidates have identical .text bytes, SHA256 341a72c3ff27a12a044c1adf5d0e7644c354ce2d4a549bf38961ce8939cce486. This supports code-address/body evidence reuse; it does not equate data, VFS tables or live hooks.
referenceProfile.knownMismatch: The installed engine loader names dbcomba5.csv and dbcombat_unittypeadjus5.csv. Importing BASE tables does not establish configured UP5 table/content equivalence.

completedSourceBackedSlices.done: A real mirrored terrain/object framebuffer now feeds the production water shader. Source horizontal clip plane and camera height inversion, target bracketing and native normal distortion inputs are evidenced. Above-water clipping, framebuffer/viewport/state restoration and pixel contributions are tested. Complete original RTT/projection/culling policy remains partial.

openSourceBackedParityGaps.gap: Configured UP content, effective VFS precedence and UP5 combat/content tables have not been imported and reconciled against the explicit BASE profile. Actual launcher selection and live memory hooks remain unobserved.

Native declared/inherited model skin lists now switch and blend alongside terrain/building ground. Native weather event queue, probabilities, RNG, durations, precipitation/wind, gameplay effects and atmospheric lighting/tint remain incomplete. Two near/far stall-door bindings refer to a missing native CSV key and retain original base material; native terrain-derived fallback is not emulated.

RPS/upgrades/splash do not cover all native attack abilities, armor, accuracy, elevation, civilization/veteran effects or the complete unit/building roster. Source profile aliases and57 roles are a bounded adapter, not all declared UnitTypes.

The native33-class terrain set is mapped onto this game's six map classes and eight rendering roles. Native map generation, exact class/overlay priority, UV transforms/autopaint and distance/detail policy are not reconstructed.

Retained material parameters do not prove all native fixed-function/IndexPal shader stages, atmospheric lighting, transparent ordering, culling and weather shader families. Current projected silhouette shadows and per-fragment lighting are rendering adapters.

Production scene reflection is now wired and pixel-tested. Remaining native gaps are separate reflected-view object culling, auxiliary plane0.02 projection/grid/UV construction, reflected near-clamp globals, exact RTT allocation/quality/refresh, complete native overlay/vertex-alpha/color/time, low/medium/palette paths and caustic linkage. Current reflection reuses main visible instances, so tall off-main-frustum objects can be absent.

openSourceBackedParityGaps.area: Ground and model binding edge cases
openSourceBackedParityGaps.gap: Two Farm model-scale bindings retain fallback scales; UnderFarm dimensions remain unresolved and excluded. Death ground images are retained/selectable, but native corpse/decal lifetime, fading and full road/sprite pipeline are not reproduced.

openSourceBackedParityGaps.area: Native CityManager beyond global urban boolean
openSourceBackedParityGaps.gap: Persistent maximum radius is now fixed. Non-BASE/civilization/technology CityRadius modifiers, other city-emitter abilities and full registration event semantics remain open. Native timestamp/owner tie selection and animated city borders are outside the boolean query; old legacy saves cannot recover already-lost radius history.

Native heading, basis, turn sign/wrap, picking rays and terrain clearance are implemented and GPU-tested. UI step/rate and pointer conversion remain adapters; full native picture-in-picture, remaining original controls and live launcher memory hooks are not established. Main keyboard/pan/save integration has its own independent root-owned QA.

explicitAdaptersAndUnverifiedScope.adapter: Own radius2 binomial class smoothing, repeat4 tiles, mask repeats5/13 and alpha perturbation. Native images are authentic; this blending algorithm is not claimed native.

Own Blinn-Phong lighting/default sun, three-step terrain-conforming projected shadow with epsilon, water repeat/opacity/Fresnel/specular/color mixing and wall-clock phase. Native source rates alone do not prove identical native time/material behavior. The approximate sky-only production reflection has been replaced by real scene capture. Its WebGL target resolution policy, geometric mirrored VP, fragment clipping and shared main/reflected instance list remain explicit adapters.

Calendar phase is derived from saved20Hz integer simulation ticks, deliberately avoiding accumulated native float-timer drift. Initial month6 and legacy fixed-summer interpretation are application defaults. Browser WebRTC lockstep, protocol9 and save extensions are this implementation's formats.

Own six-class maps, scripted skirmish AI, pathing and broader economic/ability systems remain partial reconstructions. These reports do not establish full native AI, diplomacy, territory disputed-state, trade, special-unit, campaign or all civilization rule equivalence.

The earlier header's immediate claim on a TC foundation is obsolete. Current claim code uses a completed TC with the later neighbor/Fortress requirements. That implemented slice does not settle full original territory/disputed-state semantics.

No complete match-long original rules/AI/roster equivalence audit.
historicalReportPolicy: Preserve previous reports as dated execution snapshots. native-render-evidence describes native-render1; native-combat-integration and its exhaustive WASM report precede the city-radius/parser rebuild. Their source evidence is retained, while current WASM status is bound by the reports listed as current-build-execution. The combat-season1 parity audit is archived separately. Missing production reflections, fixed-north camera and entirely static model skins are superseded findings; native weather and the explicitly retained gaps remain open.
